paras: **1-month view.** These calls change every two weeks on average and showed no forward value in the backtest. Use the 3-month view for decisions.
**Value** leads the 1-month checklist: 7 of 14 signals confirm and 4 contradict. Risk OFF is next at 8 of 14. That is a **moderate** lead.
Strongest confirmations: Low P/E +8.0%, XLB + XLF / SPY +4.0% and Gold −7.4%. Pushing against it: Highβ / Lowβ −16.0% and EM / DM −7.8%.

Your map's playbook for Value: favors Small / Large cap, XLB + XLF / SPY, Low P/E, Cyclicals / non-cyclicals, Highβ / Lowβ, Oil, Commodities and EM / DM; expects weakness in Long + Med. Gov. bonds, Corporate bonds and Gold.
Rates backdrop, context only: over 3 months yields rose about 46bp across the curve (+48bp on the 2-year, +45bp on the 10-year) with little change in slope, so there is no curve shape to read.
backdrop: **Fed:** funds rate 3.88%. The 2-year at 4.79% sits 91bp above fed funds, so the market expects hikes.
**Inflation:** Core PCE 3.0% y/y (2.0% annualized over 3 months) vs the 2% target, cooling.
**Labor:** unemployment 4.2%, initial claims 198k (4-week avg), Sahm rule calm at 0.00.

curve_table.name: Bull steepener
curve_table.note: Short rates falling fastest, so the market expects Fed cuts. Your chart calls this Risk ON, but stocks fell on average while it happened, and what came next depended on whether growth was holding up.

curve_table.name: Bull flattener
curve_table.note: Long yields falling fastest. Matches the chart's Growth playbook, and the best stretch for stocks afterwards.

curve_table.name: Bear flattener
curve_table.note: Short rates rising fastest, so the Fed is tightening. Stocks often keep rising at first; the following 3 months were the weakest of the four shapes.

curve_table.name: Bear steepener
curve_table.note: Long yields rising fastest: reflation. Matches the chart's Value playbook, and often Risk ON's too.
